requirements.text: Health check endpoint returns status and tool count GET /api/health returns a JSON response with status "ok" and the number of registered tools.
List tools returns categorized tool catalog GET /api/tools returns a JSON response with count, categories, and an ordered list of tools with name, category, and description.
Calculator endpoint rejects invalid JSON body POST /api/calc with malformed JSON body returns 400 with error 'invalid JSON'.
Calculator endpoint sanitizes and bounds numeric inputs POST /api/calc with a numeric parameter exceeding 1e13 in absolute value returns 400 with an error message.
Calculators enforce DoS-related parameter caps POST /api/calc with a capped parameter (e.g. years > 120) returns 400 with an error message specifying the max value.
Calculator wraps domain errors into 400 response POST /api/calc when the calculator function raises ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, KeyError, or TypeError returns 400 with 'invalid inputs: <message>'.
Calculator hides unexpected exceptions from client POST /api/calc when an unexpected exception occurs returns 400 with 'calculation failed'.
NAV endpoint validates scheme code GET /api/nav with code parameter that is non-numeric or longer than 9 characters returns 400 with error 'invalid scheme code'.
NAV search query length validated GET /api/nav with q parameter that is empty or longer than 80 characters returns 400 with error 'query must be 1–80 characters'.
FX rate endpoint rejects invalid currency codes GET /api/fx with base or symbols not matching the currency code pattern returns 400 with error 'invalid currency code'.
Quote endpoint validates symbol format GET /api/quote with symbol not matching the symbol pattern returns 400 with error 'invalid symbol'.
API request body size limited POST /api/* with content-length greater than 16 KB returns 413 with error 'payload too large'.

Security headers added to every HTTP response Every HTTP response from the server includes security headers: X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, Permissions-Policy, Strict-Transport-Security, Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy, and Content-Security-Policy.
